comment: Test artifact manifest. Each entry names one artifact a test can consume, the environment
variable the test reads, the file name in the cache, its size and sha256 when pinned, and
where to obtain it. tools/fetch_test_artifacts.py populates the cache from this file.
A null sha256 or bytes means the entry is not pinned yet: the tool fetches it but cannot
verify it. Pin an entry once on a machine that has the artifact with
which copies it into the cache, records bytes+sha256 here, and leaves the artifact out of git.
A test whose entry is missing from the cache skips (exit 77) instead of failing.

fixtures.name: token_corpus
fixtures.purpose: First 2048 ids of the committed benchmark corpus; exact-prefill fixtures slice it. Provenance in tests/fixtures/corpus/manifest.json.
fixtures.consumer: host-only tests that need a fixed token stream

fixtures.name: prompt_corpus
fixtures.purpose: Eight fixed, model-agnostic prompts with budgets and coarse expectations; a GPU test that needs a prompt takes one from here instead of inventing a string.
fixtures.consumer: host-only tests that validate the fixture; GPU tests that read it

artifacts.name: exl3_codec_ground_truth
artifacts.notes: Ground truth of the EXL3 contract, generated once by tests/fixtures/exl3/generate_fixture.py and committed. The test already falls back to the committed path when the variable is unset, so this entry is documentation plus a digest.

artifacts.name: qwen3_8_27b_v3_plain
artifacts.notes: Dense 27B v3 artifact. ninfer_qwen3_5_loading_real_test is argv-driven (--artifact PATH) and never runs under CTest, so it is not a consumer here. The MoE, DFlash v1 and DFlash2 tests need companions this artifact does not carry; they skip when a required component is absent.

artifacts.notes: Multi-volume: the entry file names the .part-NNNNN continuations, so the cache holds the whole set.

artifacts.name: score_w2_reference
artifacts.notes: The width-1 causal-scoring reference for the 27B, captured on trueno against the nvfp4.v3 artifact (sha256 044fc2f0..., 21,492,938,224 bytes) and recorded here so a width-2 comparison has a fixed target without a co-resident width-1 engine - no host in the lab has both the 27B and two 32 GB-class devices. The fixture records the artifact digest, the token ids, the per-position log-probabilities and the altered-token case, and the test REFUSES to compare if the digest or the token sequence differs from the artifact on the box.
